body.stop_condition: After the terminal vacuum-cylinder tau-adic causal export, declare a single local action and BV convention for Phi=rho exp(i theta), with g->exp(2 sigma)g, rho->exp(-sigma)rho, theta invariant, tau=-log(rho/f), and g_hat=(rho/f)^2 g. Include every diffeomorphism, Weyl and internal-phase ghost/antifield row, reducibility and nonminimal field required by that action. Prove the classical master equation, nilpotency, odd cyclicity, real structure and the cotangent lift. Around rho=f, construct the formal tau-adic quartet contraction and compute the reduced metric-plus-phase pairing rather than inferring health from the unreduced radial kinetic sign. Derive exactly whether the rho^2 R coupling produces an Einstein-Hilbert term and Planck scale in the rho=f chart, list the cosmological and higher-curvature couplings that remain independent, and distinguish gauge fixing from spontaneous breaking. On the vacuum cylinder and the first admissible Berger clock background, construct the principal operator and either transfer support-local advanced/retarded Green homotopies or certify the first complete-class causal obstruction. Export strict schemas, exact sparse operators, inclusion/projection/homotopy, pairings, D and internal-phase actions, and independent CME/contraction/causal verifiers.
body.current_gate: one complete action-derived classical BV and causal parent for the complex compensator-clock theory
